description: End-to-end developer and diagnostics dashboard for SLA report generation from request enqueue (Trigger API) to generator execution (Celery/PDF rendering), Parquet storage (SLA Reports API/MinIO), and delivery.

options.content:
# End-to-End SLA Report Generation & Troubleshooting Dashboard
Tracks the entire SLA report lifecycle: **Request Enqueue** (`sla-report-trigger-api`) → **Worker Execution** (`sla-report-generator` / Celery) → **Parquet Export & Storage** (`sla-reports-api` / MinIO) → **Progress & Trace Polling** (`slapg` Redis) → **Data Consolidation** (DuckDB) → **PDF Generation & Storage** (`weld-data` / `report-service`). Hover over (i) on any chart for diagnostic guidance.

panels.description: Liveness of the report trigger API. Good: UP (green). Bad: DOWN (red), new reports cannot be queued.
panels.title: Trigger API Status

panels.description: Active Celery worker container count for sla-report-generator. Good: Stable at 3 (green). Bad: <3 or 0 (yellow/red), indicates worker crash or OOM-kill.
panels.title: Generator Replicas

panels.description: Liveness of the SLA Reports API service. Good: UP (green). Bad: DOWN (red), parquet imports, consolidation, and dashboard queries fail.
panels.title: SLA Reports API Status

panels.description: Active HTTP requests currently handled concurrently by SLA Reports API. Good: Near zero (green). Bad: Sustained high values (yellow/red), indicates server backlog.
panels.title: In-Flight API Requests

panels.description: Count of report bundles imported in the last hour. Good: Positive count matching generation volume. Bad: Flat zero when reports were expected.
panels.title: Report Ingestions (1h)

panels.description: Percentage of successful DuckDB consolidation runs in the past hour. Good: 100% (green). Bad: Drops below 90% (yellow/red), indicates failed cutovers or schema errors.
panels.title: Consolidation Success %

panels.description: Rate of incoming report generation and status requests. Good: Normal spikes corresponding to report triggers. Bad: Flat zero during scheduled generation.
panels.title: Report Request Ingestion Rate

panels.description: Trigger API response status codes. Good: Mostly 202 Accepted (green). Bad: 4xx (validation/auth failure) or 5xx (Celery enqueue failure) in yellow/red.
panels.title: Trigger HTTP Response Status

panels.description: Trigger API latency percentiles. Good: Sub-second p95 (<100ms). Bad: Latency >1s, indicates Redis/Celery broker connection delays.
panels.title: Trigger Request Latency Quantiles

panels.description: CPU usage per worker container during report generation. Good: Activity peaks during generation that return to baseline. Bad: 100% saturation per core causing task stalls.
panels.title: Generator Worker CPU Usage % (per Replica)

panels.description: Worker memory usage during chart rendering and WeasyPrint PDF compilation. Good: Memory stays well below limit. Bad: Rapid climb to limit followed by sudden drop, indicating OOM kill.
panels.title: Generator Worker Memory Usage (PDF/Chart Rendering OOM Detection)
Stage 3: Parquet Export & Storage (SLA Reports API & MinIO)

panels.description: Rate of Parquet report imports into SLA Reports API. Good: Green success line tracks generation completions. Bad: Red error line appears, indicates schema or upload failure.
panels.title: Parquet Report Ingestion Rate (/import-report)

panels.description: Byte rate of Parquet datasets uploaded into MinIO via the API. Good: Bursts of throughput during report exports. Bad: Flat zero during report generation runs.
panels.title: Ingested Parquet Data Throughput

panels.description: Median (p50) and 95th percentile (p95) sizes of uploaded Parquet files. Good: Stable sizes matching report dataset volume. Bad: Abnormally small sizes indicating truncated data.
panels.title: MinIO Upload Object Size

panels.description: Latency for S3 Put, Copy, Delete, List, and Stat operations. Good: Low latency (<50ms). Bad: Latency >1s, indicates MinIO saturation or storage I/O bottleneck.
panels.title: MinIO Storage Operation Latency (p95)

panels.description: Failure rate of S3 storage operations. Good: Flat zero. Bad: Non-zero values, indicates bucket access errors, disk space issues, or network drops.
panels.title: MinIO Storage Operation Errors
Stage 4: Progress Tracking & Status Polling (Redis & API)

panels.description: Polling traffic on /status and /trace endpoints. Good: Activity aligns with active report generation. Bad: Rapid continuous polling without task progression.
panels.title: Report Progress Status/Trace Polling Request Rate

panels.description: Latency for Redis-backed progress and trace queries. Good: Fast (<20ms). Bad: Latency >100ms, indicates Redis contention or thread starvation.
panels.title: Report Progress Polling Latency (p95)
Stage 5: Data Consolidation & DuckDB Analytics (SLA Reports API)

panels.description: Executions of the DuckDB Parquet consolidation pipeline. Good: Green success line tracks scheduled runs. Bad: Red error line appears, indicates failed consolidation cutover.
panels.title: Consolidation Runs by Result

panels.description: Wall-clock duration of Parquet consolidation. Good: Stable runtime (<30s). Bad: Upward drift or spikes >60s, indicates data growth or slow S3 object transfers.
panels.title: Consolidation Wall-Clock Duration

panels.description: Query execution time across dashboard read operations. Good: Fast (<200ms). Bad: Sustained latency >1s, indicates inefficient parquet reads or heavy grouping.
panels.title: DuckDB Query Duration (p95) by Operation

panels.description: Failure rate for DuckDB query operations. Good: Flat zero. Bad: Non-zero values, indicates missing columns, corrupted parquet files, or S3 read 404s.
panels.title: DuckDB Query Errors

panels.description: Rate of rows returned by DuckDB query operations. Good: Proportional to active dashboard requests. Bad: Sudden sharp drops or unexpected spikes.
panels.title: DuckDB Rows Returned Rate
Stage 6: PDF Artifact Generation & Delivery (Weld Data & Storage)

panels.description: Cluster-wide S3 HTTP request rate into MinIO. Good: Request spikes align with PDF uploads and Parquet ingestion. Bad: Sudden complete drop to zero.
panels.title: MinIO S3 Cluster HTTP Request Rate (All Operations)

panels.description: Cluster disk space for PDF and Parquet artifacts. Good: Available capacity remains high with gradual used growth. Bad: Available capacity trends to zero.
panels.title: MinIO Cluster Total Storage Capacity

panels.description: Correlated error rates across all pipeline stages. Good: All series flat at zero. Bad: Any non-zero series immediately pinpoints where the report failed.
panels.title: Cross-Pipeline Error Matrix

panels.description: Total CPU cores used across Trigger API, Generator Workers, and SLA Reports API. Good: Bursts during generation that return to idle. Bad: Sustained high core usage.
panels.title: Pipeline Services Aggregate CPU Core Usage

panels.description: Total memory used across Trigger API, Generator Workers, and SLA Reports API. Good: Predictable usage plateaus. Bad: Continuous upward memory ramp without release (memory leak).
panels.title: Pipeline Services Memory Consumption

title: SLA Report Pipeline Diagnostics
